answer:
Africa

Method: The metadata database (SQLite) supplied region and publication_date; 6,696 articles were published in 2015. Since category labels are not stored, articles were classified into the AG News "World" category from their titles/descriptions (fetched from MongoDB) using two independent content-based classifiers: (1) a weighted keyword scorer and (2) a multinomial Naive Bayes model trained on 15,135 high-confidence seed-labeled articles from a 50,000-article sample. Both methods agree that Africa published the most World-category articles in 2015 (keyword scorer: Africa 377 vs Europe/South America 374; Naive Bayes: Africa 382 hard-count / 381.0 probability-sum, ahead of North America ~370 and South America ~367).
